{{Quote|Maybe I've spoiled the boys a bit. They've never had to do any chores. I guess I want them to be able to enjoy their childhood while they still can.|Jodi}}

'''Jodi''' is a [[Villagers|villager]] who lives in [[Pelican Town]]. She lives at [[1 Willow Lane]] with her husband [[Kent]] (who is away serving in the military until the first of Spring Year 2) and two sons, [[Sam]] and [[Vincent]].

==Schedule==
After the [[Ginger Island#Beach Resort|Beach Resort]] on Ginger Island is unlocked, Jodi may randomly spend the day there. After leaving the Island at 6pm, Jodi will immediately go home to bed. Jodi never visits the Resort on [[Festivals|Festival]] days or her checkup day at [[Harvey's Clinic]]. She also won't visit the Resort on [[Vincent]]'s checkup day.

Shown below are Jodi's schedules prioritized highest to lowest within each season. For example, if it is raining, that schedule overrides all others below it.

==Relationships==
Jodi is married to Kent and together they have two sons, Sam and Vincent.

Jodi will mention that [[Caroline]] is her best friend and that she is able to tell her anything. They also attend exercise classes along with some of the other Pelican Town ladies.

==Heart Events==
===Anytime===
At any [[friendship]] level greater than zero friendship points, you may receive a gift in the mail from Jodi.  The chance of receiving a gift in the mail increases as your friendship with Jodi increases.
{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
! style="text-align: left;" | '''Details'''&nbsp;
|-                            
| 
	{|class="wikitable"
	|-
	!Item
	!Description
	|-
	|{{Name|Basic Fertilizer|5}}{{Name|Quality Fertilizer|5}}{{Name|Basic Retaining Soil|5}}
	|Dear (Name),<p>I ordered too much fertilizer for the garden!! I bet you can put it to some good use. Take care!</p><p>-Jodi</p>
	|}
|}

===Two Hearts===
{{hearts|2}}

When the player reaches 2 hearts, they can enter her room and find a letter from her husband [[Kent]] in the drawer next to her bed.
{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="font-weight: bold;"
|-
|Details&nbsp;
|-
|style="font-weight: normal;"|{{Squote|Jodi-<p>Since I'll be coming home soon I want to tell you a few things.</p><p>I might not be the same man you remember. I've seen some things out here that have really shaken me up. I've been having a real hard time relaxing.</p><p>I don't want to scare you or make you upset. I just don't want you to be shocked when I get back.</p><p>Remember, no matter how I act, you and the kids mean everything to me.</p><p>I'll see you soon.</p>-Kent}}
|}

===Three Hearts===
{{heart event
 |hearts  = 3
 |trigger = After reaching 3 hearts, Jodi will send you a recipe in the mail.
 |details =
<table class="wikitable">
  <tr>
    <th>Image</th>
    <th>Recipe</th>
    <th>Description</th>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>{{Recipe|Fried Calamari|48}}</td>
    <td>[[Fried Calamari]]</td>
    <td>(Player),
This recipe of mine won 1st place in a cooking competition!  I hope you like it.  Thanks for being a friend!

-Jodi</td>
</table>
}}

===Four Hearts===
{{Hearts|4}}

Leave your [[farmhouse]] between 6:00am - 9:30am on a Monday to find Jodi waiting outside.
{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
|-
!style="text-align: left;"|Details&nbsp;
|-
|{{Squote|*puff*  ...hi (name)! *pant* Whew... that was quite a workout, walking all the way up here.<br />Anyway...  I came by to ask if you wanted to have dinner with us tonight!<br />You don't have to... but if you decide to come, could you please bring a largemouth bass with you?<br />...that's right.  One of those big, slimy fish from the lake.  I need one for the casserole I'm making.<br />Okay, well... it'll be at our house at around 7:00 PM tonight... don't forget the largemouth bass!  Bye.|Jodi}}
|-
|You need to bring a [[Largemouth Bass]] for her casserole at 7:00 pm when you enter her house.  This can be done on any day after Jodi invites you, except [[Festivals|festival]] days (other than [[Spirit's Eve]] and [[Dance of the Moonlight Jellies]]).
|}

==Quotes==
{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
! style="text-align: left;" | '''Regular&nbsp;'''
|-
|

'''First Meeting'''
{{Squote|Oh! You aren't exactly how I imagined... but that's okay! I'm Jodi.
It's a quiet little town, so it's very exciting when someone new moves in! Having a farmer around could really change things.}}

'''Regular'''
{{Squote|Maintaining a household is difficult work... but somebody has to do it. Yes?}}
{{Squote|Exercise is important for staying healthy. I always make sure to set aside some time for it. As a parent, I don't have much time to devote to myself. So I try and make every minute count.}}
{{Squote|I wish I could spend more time outside, but there's so much work to do.
I started wearing rubber gloves to keep my hands soft. The older you get, the more work you have to do to stay healthy. Ok, bye!}}
{{Squote|What did you say? It's [current time] already? My goodness! I still have tons of work to do!}}
{{Squote|So you're a farmer, huh? Interesting. I've never met a farmer before. Maybe some day you can teach me how to grow vegetables.}}
{{Squote|The food at JojaMart might not be the healthiest for my family, but with such low prices you'd be crazy to shop anywhere else!}}
{{Squote|Hi. Need something?}}
{{Squote|I'm so glad you're trying to improve that old farm. Once you've got everything in order, it's going to add a lot to our community! It's going to be a lot of work for you, though. Bye.}}
{{Squote|I'm taking a break from house chores today. I'm taking the day off. If I don't spend any time outside, I'll go crazy! Plus I don't want my legs to turn soft.}}

''If Joja has closed''
{{Squote|The food at [[Pierre's General Store|Pierre's]] is so much fresher and healthier than anything I ever bought at [[JojaMart]]. I do miss those cheap Joja prices, though.}}

''If sold high quality crops to [[Pierre's General Store|Pierre]]''
{{Squote|Hi... did you sell [item] to the general store the other day? I think I bought it... It was pretty high-quality stuff. As soon as I smelled it I was back in Granny's old cottage...}}

''Before [[Kent]]'s return''
{{Squote|My husband Kent is a soldier, working overseas. That's why he's not here right now. I know he'll come back safe once his tour is over! Need something?}}
{{Squote|Yesterday I visited [[Yoba]]'s Altar to ask for my husband's safe return. I'm trying to stay positive, but it's hard sometimes.}}

''After Kent's return''
{{Squote|Kent has been home for a while now, but he still seems uneasy.}}

''If Player is married to [[Sam]]''
{{Squote|How's Sam doing? I have to admit, there's less cooking and cleaning to do since he moved out...}}

''6+ Hearts''
{{Squote|It's nice to have a family... but I'd be lying if I said I never long for the freedom of youth...}}
{{Squote|Where does all the time go? *sigh* I remember when Sam was a little baby wearing diapers. He was such a cute little kid. Don't tell him I said that. You must really like talking to me, huh?}}
{{Squote|*sigh*... Sometimes I dream about life on my own... without a family to look after. Is that horrible? Don't tell anyone.}}

''8+ Hearts''
{{Squote|I had a dream that I had complete freedom, no obligation to anyone but myself...
...Then I woke up and realized I had a full day of house chores ahead of me...
But I don't regret having a family [Player]...Sam and Vincent mean everything to me!}}
{{Squote|We kind of rushed into our marriage, with Kent being a soldier and all... I hardly got a taste of youth and freedom, and now it's too late to ever go back. Just don't make the same mistake.}}

'''Doctor Visit'''

''In the clinic's examination room''
{{Squote|Hey! You can't just barge into a private appointment!}}

'''Vincent's Doctor Visit'''

''Before leaving home for [[Vincent]]'s doctor visit''
{{Squote|Vincent hates going to the doctor more than anything, but he'll just have to deal with it.}}

''In the clinic's waiting room with Vincent''
{{Squote|Be brave, Vincent. Think of your father.}}

''In the clinic's examination room with Vincent''
{{Squote|Doctor Harvey? I'm worried about Vincent's height. Isn't he a little short for his age?}}

'''Summer'''
{{Squote|Summer is nice, but it also means more work. I'll have to keep the garden in shape on top of working in the house!}}
{{Squote|Hello. Do you need something? I'm a little busy.}}
{{Squote|Housework is frustrating because you're never finished. The day after I sweep the floor, it's dirty again.}}
{{Squote|What in the world am I going to make for dinner? *sigh*...}}

'''Green Rain'''

''Year 1''
{{Squote|Are you alright? We've never seen anything like this before... I wish my husband was here. He'd know exactly what to do.}}
''Year 2+''
{{Squote|Vincent got up early to go play in the rain. I just hope they're right about it being completely harmless!}}

'''Fall'''
{{Squote|Maybe I've spoiled the boys a bit. They've never had to do any chores. I guess I want them to be able to enjoy their childhood while they still can. Well, Sam's basically a man now, though. I hope he hasn't grow up to be lazy. That won't do. Being a parent isn't very easy.}}
{{Squote|[[Caroline]] and I are good friends. I tell her everything.}}
{{Squote|When you become a parent, you have to leave your old lifestyle behind. Maybe that's not entirely true... but if you're not careful, it will happen.}}

'''Winter'''
{{Squote|I loved playing in the snow when I was a kid. The great thing about being a mother is that I get to enjoy it again.}}
{{Squote|Hi. Do you get tired of people asking about your farm all the time? I think I would.}}
{{Squote|What do I do for fun? Hmm... That'a a good question. I like sleeping.}}
{{Squote|[[Sam]] makes a lot of noise with that music of his. I hope it doesn't disturb the neighbors.}}
{{Squote|It would be nice to take a vacation once in a while...}}
{{Squote|If I was rich the first thing I'd do would be to hire a maid and a chef. My goodness, that would be nice!}}

'''If the player starts dating Sam'''

{{Squote|I heard about you and Sam. Hopefully he won't cause you any trouble!}}

'''If the player marries Sam'''
{{Squote|I'm so happy for you and Sam. I think you two are the perfect match!}}
{{Squote|I never thought I'd say it... but I'll miss those awful noises from Sam's guitar...}}

'''At Ginger Island'''
{{Squote|What a treat!}}
{{Squote|The view is breathtaking! Deep blue as far as the eye can see...}}
{{Squote|We all love it when Gus shows up.}}
{{Squote|I think I'll make seafood tonight.}}
|}

{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
! style="text-align: left;" | '''Events&nbsp;'''
|-
|

'''[[Egg Festival]]'''

''Odd-numbered year''
{{Squote|Vincent loves this festival... it's a joy to see him so happy.}}
''Even-numbered year''
{{Squote|Kent always seems a little antsy during big gatherings like this...}}


'''[[Desert Festival]]'''
{{Squote|Oh, don't mind me. I'm just doing a little shopping.
If I don't browse the shops, I might miss the perfect decoration for our living room!}}

'''[[Flower Dance]]'''

''Odd-numbered year''
{{Squote|Are you going to be dancing today, [Player]?}}
''Even-numbered year''
{{Squote|I have special earrings I only wear once a year for this event. They're little daffodils... see?}}

'''[[Luau|The Luau]]'''
{{Squote|I hope the soup is good this year.}}

'''[[Dance of the Moonlight Jellies]]'''
{{Squote|There! I just saw something glowing! Oh... It's gone.}}

'''[[Stardew Valley Fair]]'''
{{Squote|He doesn't look very happy... I guess Mayor Lewis had to cut costs with a budget clown this year}}

'''[[Spirit's Eve]]'''
{{Squote|Vincent's upset that I won't let him go into the haunted maze... but he's just a little boy!}}

'''[[Festival of Ice]]'''
{{Squote|The forest looks beautiful in the winter, doesn't it?}}

'''[[Night Market]]'''
{{Squote|It must be so thrilling to travel the world like they do... *sigh*...}}

'''[[Feast of the Winter Star]]'''
{{Squote|It's not a good time of year for a diet...}}

|}

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Jodi's Request|"Jodi's Request"]]: Jodi will send you a letter on the 19th of [[Spring]] requesting a [[Cauliflower]].  The reward is {{Price|350}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart.
*[[Quests#Fish Casserole|"Fish Casserole"]]: After reaching 4 hearts with Jodi, she will visit your farm and invite you to dinner at her house, requesting that you bring a [[Largemouth Bass]].  There is no reward other than a cutscene.
*Jodi may randomly request an item at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]].  The reward is 3x the item's base value and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
